Don't over prepare. Pretend a friend posted this job and you are talking to him/her. Tell him/her what you like about it, how you would be a good fit and ask questions about the position just as you would ask a friend. I've interviewed many people and have been interviewed many times. Bullshit and fakery are big no no's. Most important - if you don't know the answer to something DON'T TRY TO BULLSHIT YOUR WAY THROUGH IT. Just say you're not completely familiar with whatever it is and ask them to explain. Don't appear fake. If a friend told you about this job opening, and you wanted to know more, what would you ask?

Wear a suit, you cannot be overdressed for an interview. If you don't have one, go get a solid color button down shirt, khakis, and a tie. Bring a notepad and 2 pens. Write down any questions you think of during the interview so you can ask it later . Plan to arrive 20 minutes early. Go into the building about 10-15 minutes early. Gives you time to find the office and fill out any necessary paperwork.

Research the company before the interview, find out what you can about the industry they are in. What do they sell and who do they sell it to?

When you are getting interviewed, if they ask a question that you don't know, say "I'm not sure, but..." and take a guess at it. Ask them why they have the job opening and if they have ever had to do layoffs. At the end of the interview, ask when can you expect to hear back from them.
